description: See what your apps take up, and where there is room to clear cache and logs.
introTitle: Your apps, with the space explained.
introDescription: Compare reported installation sizes with the cache and logs Kudu can offer for review. Find the biggest opportunities before you clean.
privacy: Analysis stays on this device. Nothing is removed during analysis.
inventoryNote: Installed apps and known cleaner targets
cacheNote: Measured eligible cache and log files
scope: Partial view: installation sizes are reported estimates; cache and logs are measured from supported cleaner rules. These figures may overlap and are not added together. Recent, excluded and inaccessible files, personal data and leftover installations are not included.
inventoryUnavailable: Installed app inventory could not be loaded.
partial: {{count}} cleaner rules could not be checked.
noApps: No supported apps or cache files were found.
installedNote: Reported by the app inventory. Removing an app requires its uninstaller.
personalNote: Your documents, projects, saves and personal app data are not measured here. Cache-owner rows may represent shared tools or apps no longer installed.
reviewNote: Checks these rules again and opens a fresh Cleaner review. You choose what to remove; cache may rebuild and some rules may reset app state.
scanError: App space could not be analyzed. Try again.
reviewError: Could not prepare a fresh cleanup review. Try refreshing the analysis.
cleanerBusy: Wait for the current Cleaner operation to finish before reviewing app cache.
nothingLeft: No eligible files remain for this app. Refresh the analysis to update its sizes.
